question: Should this PR wait for a real current-head `/new` or `/reset` run using a non-default slug model, or should the existing shared-resolver contract tests be accepted as an explicit proof override?
rationale: The implementation is correct by source and focused contract coverage, but repository policy requires after-fix real behavior proof for external non-docs PRs and the PR explicitly states no authenticated provider call was run.

options.title: Require live routing proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until redacted logs or terminal output show the current head selecting the configured slug model in a real session-memory run.

options.title: Override the proof gate
options.body: Accept the handler seam tests plus existing embedded-runner E2E and model-selection tests as sufficient for this narrowly delegated routing change.
